title: Apple won't be able to meet demand in Q3
description: During his last call with investors before stepping down, Apple CEO Tim Cook laid out that the upcoming September quarter (Q3) will have huge customer demand that the supply chain won't be able to meet. Cook stressed that it isn't a case of RAM constraints or lack of parts, but that, put simply, customer demand for iPhones, iPads, and Macs is too great, and supply partners can't keep up. He said, "this isn't a partner or supplier issue. The issue is an incredibly strong demand." That means that the supply chain is capable of completing Apple orders at the usual scale, but that the...

title: Samsung's upcoming Galaxy SmartTag3 will have a new shape
description: Samsung launched the original Galaxy SmartTag in 2021, and the SmartTag2 in 2023. Now it seems like it's almost ready to release the SmartTag3, but this will come with a twist. According to the leaked illustrations you can see below, the next Galaxy SmartTag will have a new, squircle-like shape. That said, it doesn't seem to have a built-in lanyard hole, so you may need to buy separate cases to attach it to your keys. There's apparently a button in the center, similar to the one on the original SmartTag. Pressing it could help you find your connected Galaxy phone, and...

title: Qualcomm chipsets are officially getting a price hike
description: Following speculation about an imminent price hike on its chipsets, Qualcomm has officially confirmed that it will indeed raise its Snapdragon chip prices across the board. As confirmed by CEO Cristiano Amon during an interview with CNBC, Snapdragon chips will be more expensive from September 1. Amon cited the increase in input costs across the entire chipset production process as the main reason for the imminent price hikes. A separate press release from Qualcomm outlined that the company can no longer absorb the increased production costs without raising its product...

title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra review
Xiaomi Pad 8S Pro is on the way with Xiaomi's next self-developed chipset at the helm
description: The Xiaomi Pad 8 Pro made its debut in September of last year, and now the company is apparently working on a new model called the Xiaomi Pad 8S Pro. The leaked image below shows part of the upcoming device’s About screen, which reveals all of its main specs. The tablet is powered by Xiaomi's own Xring O3 SoC, paired with 16GB of RAM. It has a 50MP camera on the rear (and a 2MP secondary camera), and a 32MP selfie camera. The Pad 8S Pro 12.5 has a 12,000 mAh battery, and it will launch running HyperOS 4, which is probably based on Android 17. As this screen is in Chinese, and taking...

title: Samsung Galaxy F70 Pro to launch next week, key features and pricing revealed
description: Yesterday, an online retailer in India teased the arrival of the Samsung Galaxy F70 Pro. Now, Samsung has revealed the handset's launch date and confirmed some of its key specifications. The Samsung Galaxy F70 Pro will launch in India on August 3 and will be available for purchase through Flipkart and Samsung's official online store. According to its official product page on Samsung India's website, the Galaxy F70 Pro will be powered by the Snapdragon 6 Gen 3 chipset, paired with up to 8GB of LPDDR5X RAM and 256GB of UFS 3.1 storage. For photography, the phone will feature a...

title: Motorola Moto Pad 70 Groove arrives with a 12.1" display, a 9-unit JBL Pro Speaker System, and a 10,200 mAh battery
description: Motorola introduced the Moto Pad 70 Pro last month, and today, it unveiled the Moto Pad 70 Groove, advertised as the "ultimate entertainment tablet designed for consumers who demand immersive entertainment, cinematic sound, premium design, and limitless versatility." Motorola tries to deliver all of that with a 12.1" 120Hz LCD of 2,560x1,600-pixel resolution having an 800 nits peak brightness, 98% DCI-P3 color gamut, and support for Dolby Vision and HDR10. The Moto Pad 70 Groove features a 9-unit JBL Pro Speaker System on its back, including four tweeters, three woofers, and two...

title: Strong iPhone demand and services revenue propelled Apple’s Q3 earnings
description: It was another record-breaking quarter for Apple as strong iPhone demand and revenue from its services were enough to overcome the global memory chip supply constraints that are plaguing the industry. Revenues stood at $109.4 billion - up 16% compared to last year. Net profits came in at $29.8 billion, which is a 27% lift from Q3,2025. Apple had yet another strong quarter of iPhone demand with revenues reaching $54.2 billion for the three-month period ending on June 27, 2026. The figure represents a 21% rise compared to the same time last year. The services division, which...

title: OnePlus N6x debuts with a Dimensity 6360 Apex chipset, a 7,000mAh battery
description: After several teasers, OnePlus has officially launched the N6x in India. The new handset is a more affordable version of the OnePlus N6, which debuted late last month. The OnePlus N6x features a 6.8-inch LCD display with an HD+ resolution and a refresh rate of up to 120Hz. Under the hood, the phone is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 6360 Apex chipset, paired with 4GB of RAM and up to 128GB of internal storage. It also includes a microSD card slot for storage expansion. One of the key highlights of the OnePlus N6x is its large 7,000mAh battery, which the company claims can...

title: vivo S2's launch date and design revealed
description: vivo started teasing the S2 earlier this week, and today, its Indian branch revealed the smartphone will be unveiled on August 6 at 12 PM IST. The promo page set up by vivo on its official Indian website also includes an image of the S2, revealing its design. On the front is a curved display with a punch-hole in the center for the selfie camera. Around the back is a horizontally aligned camera island, housing two cameras and a circular flash. On the vivo S2's right side frame, made of plastic, are the volume rocker and power button. At the top are the secondary mic and...

title: Tecno teases Borderless Concept phone with 0mm display bezels
description: Smartphones with ultra-thin bezels have been around for years, but a truly bezelless display has remained out of reach. Tecno is now looking to change that with its Next-Gen Borderless Concept Phone, a prototype device featuring a display with true zero bezels. Tecno has confirmed in an official press release that its Next-Gen Borderless Concept phone features a display with 0mm bezels. The concept device will be showcased at IFA 2026 in Berlin this September. According to the company, the 0mm display bezels were achieved through “advanced internal stacking, new screen packaging...

title: Redmi K100 Pro Max launch date and design officially revealed
description: Just yesterday, a leaked image of the Redmi K100 Pro surfaced online, showing the phone in a cherry red finish. Now, Xiaomi has officially revealed the K100 Pro Max design and confirmed its launch date. The Redmi K100 Pro series will launch in China on August 11, the company confirmed in an official Weibo post. In a separate post, Redmi shared official renders of the K100 Pro Max in a new Cabernet Red colorway, which matches the recently leaked image. The company also confirmed that the K100 Pro Max will feature a flat 6.9-inch display with ultra-narrow bezels. The handset gets a...

title: Xiaomi 18 and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max certification hints at both of them going global
description: A few days ago a rumor claimed Xiaomi would be launching the 18 Pro in global markets, unlike its predecessor. Now, a tipster over on X has revealed that two Xiaomi devices have been certified by the EEC. They have the model numbers 2609BPN61G and 2611FPNFAG and the tipster claims the former could be the Xiaomi 18 Pro Max and the latter the Xiaomi 18. The certification basically confirms that these are launching outside of China. While the Xiaomi 18 getting a global launch isn't a surprise, since its predecessor did too, the Xiaomi 17 Pro Max was only available in China, so its successor...

title: Samsung is also working on a pair of Galaxy Buds with an ear hook design
description: Yesterday we showed you what the Samsung Galaxy Buds On will look like, thanks to some leaked illustrations. Today the same source is back with new ones, only these are depicting a different pair of earbuds. Specifically, earbuds with an ear hook design. These are reportedly internally codenamed Buds Canal 5, and like all similar products that are already on the market, they are said to be targeting workout and running use. They have flat hooks and an ear tip design that could be either in-ear or semi-in-ear. Although it's not pictured here, these will most likely come with a...

title: Google brings Nano Banana 2 to Google Earth
description: Google's Nano Banana 2 AI image generation model is now available in Google Earth. It can generate custom images using Google Earth’s satellite, aerial, and 3D imagery. All you need to do is zoom in to a place in Google Earth on the web, tap "create image", and describe what you want to see in it. Then, Nano Banana 2 will create it for you. Google says teachers can use this to render hyper-realistic views of historic places and events, like transforming the Pompeii ruins into a bustling Roman city (as seen in the video above). You can also create custom infographics to...

title: New Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold renders leak
description: Google is unveiling the Pixel 11 family on August 12, and today some promotional renders of the Pixel 11 Pro Fold have been leaked by the legendary Evan Blass, aka @evleaks. One of these renders confirms that the phone has an 8" inner display, while another one tells us that the marketing around the Pixel 11 family (and the Pro Fold specifically) will be centered around Gemini Intelligence. title: iPhone driver's licenses are coming to another state
description: iPhone and Apple Watch users in Oklahoma will soon be able to add their driver's licenses and IDs to the Apple Wallet app. Apple is in fact already working on supporting this feature in its backend systems, according to a new report. Oklahoma passed a House bill in March that allows Service Oklahoma to issue mobile or digital versions of stated ID cards and driver’s licenses, and this is a consequence of that bill. These digital IDs and driver’s licenses are not intended to replace the physical versions, so people in Oklahoma will still need to have the latter. The digital versions...

title: Spotify gets a Running Mode
description: Spotify has now added a new Running Mode to its iOS app for Premium subscribers in the US, Canada, the UK, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand, and Sweden. If you are in one of the supported countries and have an iPhone, you should be able to find the Running Mode in the Fitness Hub already. Inside the Running Mode you will find 25 curated running playlists, which you can customize by workout type, duration, beats per minute, and what type of music you're in the mood for. Once you press play, Spotify will guide your run with music tailored to your workout. The playlist "seamlessly moves...

title: DJI Osmo Pocket 4P goes global
description: Following its announcement last month, DJI has now expanded the Osmo Pocket 4P’s availability outside of China. The flagship vlogging camera is now available across Europe, Canada and Australia but notably absent from the US due to the ongoing FCC ban on foreign-made camera and drone equipment. With the Pocket 4P, DJI is bringing a dual-lens setup. There’s an all-new 1-inch main sensor with LOFIC technology, an f/2.0 aperture, and an equivalent focal length of 20mm. title: Redmi K100 Pro leaks with vibrant red color
description: The Redmi K100 Pro continues to leak ahead of its launch. A new poster making rounds on Weibo gives us our best look at the device yet. The overall design looks similar to the Redmi K90 Pro Max with a triple camera setup inside an island configuration. We can also spot what appears to be a subwoofer, which could again feature Bose branding and sound tuning. The more interesting bit is the color choice.
